description: This source file defines a React component for an interactive role-specific roadmap visualization and mind map within a Next.js project. It includes functions, types, and components for rendering milestones, stages, categories, nodes, and edges, along with user interactions like panning, zooming, node dragging, and tooltip display. It also contains logic for managing application state and generating role-specific data.
